verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Dynamic Configs as a first-class object, distinct from boolean Feature Gates. They can be managed via the CLI, retrieved via the HTTP API, and scoped by target apps. Experiments serve multiple variants (A/B/n), so non-boolean config serving is clearly part of the product. However, no item describes what a Dynamic Config contains or confirms string, number, or JSON value types, and Feature Gates themselves return only pass/fail. Missing for 10: explicit docs on Dynamic Config value types (strings/numbers/JSON) and SDK getters for typed values, multivariate flag documentation beyond experiment variants, independent or hands-on corroboration.
